column1: # The record's levers (examples/learner --propose reads this): the lever as the record names it, the lever it is read as (- for itself), what the run did.
# A lever renamed when the learner took it over keeps one series under the new name: forget's rows are stride's history (docs/234).
# Since docs/236 the stride is the learner's state, carried in the checkpoint, and a run is named by what it does besides (docs/235).

# A lever read as ! is not a lever to pull - a change of measure, or the learner's own state that every checkpoint carries: kept so the next row's gain is read against it, never proposed (docs/237, 238).
